BiblicalUsage: Midnight is the middle of the night, and it is the hour God chooses for His great acts. He goes out into Egypt about midnight to strike the firstborn, the mighty are taken away at midnight without hand, and the psalmist rises at midnight to give thanks.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe midnight belongs to God as much as midday. He judges at midnight and He is praised at midnight, and the dark hour is His hour too.
RelatedEvents: The Ten Plagues; The Death of the Firstborn
